author: scombat
notes: Replay: uv run bench classify litellm-heuristic --prompts ... --out ... --author ... (no model, no network). LiteLLM's heuristic complexity scorer, tiers translated name to name: SIMPLE -> low, MEDIUM -> medium, COMPLEX -> high, REASONING -> expert (no trivial). The raw score of LiteLLM is in decisions.jsonl with the tier, the signals and the cause; it is not on the v7 scale, so labels.jsonl has no score and the score is for rank metrics only. Each prompt alone, system_prompt None, LiteLLM's default configuration. task and needs_tools are null. Code copied verbatim (v1.106.6), see src/s1d1_bench/vendor/litellm_heuristic/NOTICE.md.
